schema: VietlishCorpusEntry (src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts) - { vietlish, natural, sourcePattern, category, frequency, context }
author: F1 (Content Factory)
definition: Tenth-wave candidate Vietnamese-L1 interference items for human review before promotion into VIETLISH_CORPUS. Focus areas: gerund/preposition governance, clause-chain literal translations, relative-clause word order, adjective false friends, causatives, and work/service register softening.
dedupedAgainst: F1 local check against live VIETLISH_CORPUS, pending waves 1-5 on main, fetched in-flight waves 6/7/8, and F1 wave9 branch; case-insensitive vietlish matching.
